d:
Experience the magic of early 2000s Bollywood romance with “Jaaneman Tujhko Jo Paya” from the movie Khwahish (2003). Beautifully sung by K.K. and Asha Bhosle, this romantic melody features Mallika Sherawat and Himanshu Malik and captures the passionate, youthful sound of Bollywood's 2000s era.
